title: Sunday · the Fourth, 2013
logline: The dock three days after the Fourth: the lawn chair, a bassinet beside it in the shade of the shack, the girl of three chalking the planks, Gully's back at the grill. The son is three months old and in the strip for the first time, as a bassinet.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the lawn chair on the dock with a woman in it and a bassinet in the shack's shade beside her.

image.prompt: a woman with a dark braid in an old lawn chair on a dock with a wicker bassinet in the shade of a shingle shack beside her, watercolor

panels.name: Chair

panels.composition: Tier 2: a small girl chalking the planks, a crab shape, spent firework tubes swept into a pile.

image.prompt: a small girl drawing a crab shape in chalk on dock planks beside a swept pile of spent firework tubes, watercolor

panels.name: Chalk

panels.composition: Tier 3: Gully's back at the grill, smoke, the bay flat behind.

image.prompt: a stocky man in an apron at a grill from behind with smoke rising and a flat bay beyond, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Grill

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: The son, b. spring 2013, as a bassinet.
